profile.headline: Full-Stack Angular/.Net Software Engineer | Constant Learner | Detail Lover
profile.summary:
As a lifelong learner there have been many things to which I've had the pleasure of delving myself into. It all started with learning to sing. My desire and will to succeed in this first venture have served as evidence of what can be done when I put my mind to accomplish what I truly want.

This evidence was later used to confirm my ability in myself and to fuel my desire to learn to play the guitar, speak Russian, speak Spanish, and to learn to code. The majority of my hobbies and things I enjoy in life revolve around learning, enjoying how good it feels to overcome obstacles, and making progress over time. I've been able to turn learning to code into more than just a hobby through my time at Tech Elevator. Throughout my software engineering career I will always be pushing to learn more to expand my knowledge.

Send me a message and let's connect!

positions.title: Registered Nurse
positions.description:
Efficiently streamlined and coordinated center physician visits ensuring timely and accurate completion of the physician’s tasks.  

Consistently achieved the lowest error rate in regards to QPIs and quality measurement standards among all nurses.

positions.title: Registered Nurse
positions.description:
Improved patient and family outcomes through education, nursing care, and by using an empathetic approach to the nursing process. 

Maximized the utilization of time management skills in administering and documenting all patient care in a timely manner.
